blueprints.name: Ventra-EMS — air conditioner (relays)
blueprints.description: Lets Ventra-EMS switch an air conditioner through its relays: heating and cooling (fill in only the ones the device has). While the device's Ventra-EMS "take control" (switch.ems_<id>_take_control) is on, each device switch follows its Ventra-EMS relay (switch.ems_<id>_heating_relay, switch.ems_<id>_cooling_relay): on = allowed, off = blocked. Each relay can have extra conditions of your own (for example a room temperature): the switch is only on when the Ventra-EMS relay is on and those conditions are met. blueprints.name: Ventra-EMS — SolarEdge StorEdge battery
blueprints.description: Lets Ventra-EMS charge and discharge the battery of a SolarEdge StorEdge inverter through the storage remote control of the SolarEdge Modbus Multi integration. While the battery's Ventra-EMS "take control" (switch.ems_<id>_take_control) is on, the storage control mode is set to remote control and the Ventra-EMS setpoint (number.ems_<id>_battery_power, in W: − = charge, + = discharge) decides the command: discharge with the setpoint as discharge limit, or charge with it as charge limit (the other limit is 0). While take control is off, the storage control mode is disabled and the command mode set to off, so the inverter runs its own mode again. Checked every 5 seconds and when take control changes. The command mode is written every time (it keeps the inverter's remote control command timeout from running out); the rest only when it differs. The limits' unit (W or kW) is read from the entities and the values are kept inside their range. Only battery control: limiting the production of a SolarEdge inverter is the separate glueprint "SolarEdge inverter limit". Version 2.

blueprints.name: Ventra-EMS — Solax battery

While the battery's Ventra-EMS "take control" (switch.ems_<id>_take_control) is on, the Ventra-EMS setpoint (number.ems_<id>_battery_power, in W: − = charge, + = discharge) goes to the inverter's remote control active power (Solax: + = charge), remote control is enabled and triggered. blueprints.name: Ventra-EMS — Solax hybrid G4/G5/G6 (battery + export limit)
blueprints.description: Lets Ventra-EMS drive a Solax hybrid inverter (Gen4, Gen5, Gen6) with one automation: its battery and its PV power, so Ventra-EMS can also limit the export. It uses the "PV and BAT control" remote control (mode 8) of the Solax Modbus integration. While the battery's Ventra-EMS "take control" is on, the battery follows the Ventra-EMS setpoint (W, + = discharge, − = charge) and the PV power is capped at the inverter's Ventra-EMS power limit when its "limit control" is on (else the maximum PV power). While only the limit control is on, the inverter balances the house itself ("Enabled Grid Control", grid target 0) and the PV power is capped. While both are off, remote control is disabled and the inverter runs its own mode again. Written every 5 seconds. Older Solax inverters without mode 8: the glueprint "Solax battery". Version 1.

blueprints.name: Ventra-EMS — Solis hybrid battery
blueprints.description: Lets Ventra-EMS charge and discharge the battery of a Solis hybrid inverter through the remote control (RC force charge / discharge) of the Solis Modbus integration (Pho3niX90/solis_modbus). While the battery's Ventra-EMS "take control" (switch.ems_<id>_take_control) is on, the Ventra-EMS setpoint (number.ems_<id>_battery_power, in W: − = charge, + = discharge) decides the command: force discharge with the setpoint as discharge power, or force charge with it as charge power (the other power is 0). The command is selected first and every cycle: Solis only accepts the powers after it, and it keeps the inverter's RC timeout (1–30 min) from running out. The powers are only written when they differ. While take control is off, the command goes to "None", so the inverter runs its own mode again. Checked every 15 seconds and when take control changes. The powers' unit (W or kW) is read from the entities and the values are kept inside their range. Version 1.

blueprints.name: Ventra-EMS — Victron ESS battery
blueprints.description: Lets Ventra-EMS charge and discharge a stand-alone Victron ESS battery through its ESS AC grid setpoint (e.g. number.ess_ac_grid_setpoint, in W: + = charge the battery, − = discharge it). While the battery's Ventra-EMS "take control" (switch.ems_<id>_take_control) is on, the Ventra-EMS setpoint (number.ems_<id>_battery_power, in W: − = charge, + = discharge) is written to the ESS setpoint with the sign turned round, kept inside its range. While take control is off, the ESS setpoint goes back to the value for "released" (usually 0), so ESS runs on its own again. Checked every 5 seconds and when take control changes; written only when the value differs. The ESS setpoint's unit (W or kW) is read from the entity. Version 2.

blueprints.name: Ventra-EMS — OCPP EV charger
blueprints.description: Lets Ventra-EMS charge an EV through a charger in the OCPP integration (lbbrhzn/ocpp). While the charger's Ventra-EMS "take control" (switch.ems_<id>_take_control) is on and a car is plugged in, the Ventra-EMS power (number.ems_<id>_power, in W: − = charging) is turned into a charging current (amps = power ÷ (phases × voltage), kept between the minimum and maximum current and rounded to the current step) on the charger's maximum current, and charging is switched on. While take control is off, charging is switched off and the maximum current goes back to the minimum. Checked every 15 seconds (OCPP chargers need time per command), when a car is plugged in and when take control changes. Version 2.

blueprints.name: Ventra-EMS — SolarEdge inverter limit
blueprints.description: Lets Ventra-EMS limit the production of a SolarEdge inverter (SolarEdge Modbus Multi). While the inverter's Ventra-EMS "limit control" (switch.ems_<id>_limit_control) is on, the limit control mode is set to production control and the site limit follows the Ventra-EMS power limit (number.ems_<id>_power_limit, in W; the site limit's own unit W or kW is read and the value kept inside its range). blueprints.name: Ventra-EMS — relay device
blueprints.description: Lets Ventra-EMS switch a relay device: a boiler, pool pump, heater or anything a switch, smart plug or relay can turn on and off. While the device's Ventra-EMS "take control" (switch.ems_<id>_take_control) is on, the device switch follows its Ventra-EMS relay (switch.ems_<id>_relay): on = the device may run, off = blocked.
